name: firebaseui-web
description: FirebaseUI is an open-source JavaScript library for Web that provides simple, customizable UI bindings on top of Firebase SDKs to eliminate boilerplate code and promote best practices.

latest_release.name: v7.1.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6.4.0 to 7.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1419
* chore(deps): bump actions/stale from 10.3.0 to 10.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1417
* chore(deps): bump @vitest/ui from 4.1.9 to 4.1.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1415
* fix(ci): remove .npmrc registry override that breaks all CI workflows by @just1and0 in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1425
* chore(deps): bump vitest from 4.1.9 to 4.1.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1408
* chore(deps): bump actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1421
* ci: add needs-attention labeling when OP responds by @russellwheatley in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1426
* chore(deps): bump actions/stale from 10.4.0 to 11.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1428
* **feat(auth): implement  legacyFetchSignInWithEmail behaviour for Angular and React by @russellwheatley in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1343**
* **feat(auth): onUpgradeFailure callback when account linking fails by @russellwheatley in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1355**
* chore(deps): bump pnpm/action-setup from 6.0.9 to 6.0.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1435
* chore(deps): bump the angular group across 1 directory with 14 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1436
* chore(deps): bump @radix-ui/react-progress from 1.1.11 to 1.1.16 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1441
* chore(deps): bump @playwright/test from 1.61.1 to 1.62.1 in the playwright group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1439
* docs: V7 doc update to point to general release by @russellwheatley in https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/pull/1427


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/firebase/firebaseui-web/compare/v7.0.3...v7.0.4
